items.title: Russell Brand tells court allegations made friends and colleagues turn against him
items.summary: The entertainer is giving evidence at his trial on charges including rape and assault, which he denies.

items.title: Tommy Robinson guilty of harassing two journalists
items.summary: Tommy Robinson has been found guilty of harassing two MailOnline journalists.

items.title: Tommy Robinson guilty of harassing two Daily Mail journalists
items.summary: The 43-year-old is convicted after a week-long trial at Southwark Crown Court.

items.title: Paedophile who sexually abused infant and incited rape of another child jailed
items.summary: A paedophile who sexually abused an infant and incited the rape of another child has been jailed for 10-and-a-half years.

items.title: Legal bid to overturn Drumcree march ban fails
items.summary: The High Court in Belfast has ruled that Sir Chris Bryant's decision made on 9 October was lawful.

items.title: Ban on Drumcree Orange Order parade was lawful, High Court rules
items.summary: The Northern Ireland secretary's decision to ban the Drumcree Orange Order parade was lawful, a High Court judge has concluded.
